mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO grounded_run_control (run_id, owner_key, request_id, state, generation) VALUES (#{identity.runId}, #{identity.ownerKey}, #{identity.requestId}, 'RUNNING', #{identity.generation})
mapper.select: SELECT run_id, owner_key, request_id, state, generation FROM grounded_run_control WHERE owner_key = #{identity.ownerKey} AND request_id = #{identity.requestId} FOR UPDATE
